1.title: Judge Ends Federal Oversight of Oakland Police After 23 Years
1.summary: In ending the longest such monitoring in U.S. history, a federal court said the department had mostly complied with reforms mandated by a 2003 settlement after a police brutality lawsuit.

2.title: What we know about Cornell University frat house rape investigation
2.summary: The woman alleges she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house at the university two years ago.

3.title: Ken Paxton, G.O.P. Nominee in Texas, Privately Said Trump’s Convention Hurt Him
3.summary: Ken Paxton, one of the party’s top Senate candidates and a Trump loyalist, said that “everybody’s numbers dropped” after the event, according to audio obtained by The Times.

4.title: Live Updates: Passengers Intervene After Clash in Cockpit on Israel-Bound Flight
4.summary: The pilot and co-pilot of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv were hospitalized with injuries after the plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, Saudi officials said. The episode raised fears of a hijacking, though it was not immediately clear what had prompted the clash.

5.title: Africa's richest man to launch Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
5.summary: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.

6.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
6.summary: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.
